fixtures_nonnegative_scores.name: fixtures_nonnegative_scores
fixtures_nonnegative_scores.value:
("fixtures"."home_score" IS NULL OR "fixtures"."home_score" >= 0)
        AND ("fixtures"."away_score" IS NULL OR "fixtures"."away_score" >= 0)
        AND (
          "fixtures"."regulation_home_score" IS NULL
          OR "fixtures"."regulation_home_score" >= 0
        )
        AND (
          "fixtures"."regulation_away_score" IS NULL
          OR "fixtures"."regulation_away_score" >= 0
        )

fixtures_confirmed_regulation_scores.name: fixtures_confirmed_regulation_scores
fixtures_confirmed_regulation_scores.value:
NOT "fixtures"."regulation_confirmed"
        OR (
          "fixtures"."regulation_home_score" IS NOT NULL
          AND "fixtures"."regulation_away_score" IS NOT NULL
        )

result_snapshots_nonnegative_scores.name: result_snapshots_nonnegative_scores
result_snapshots_nonnegative_scores.value:
(
          "result_snapshots"."regulation_home_score" IS NULL
          OR "result_snapshots"."regulation_home_score" >= 0
        )
        AND (
          "result_snapshots"."regulation_away_score" IS NULL
          OR "result_snapshots"."regulation_away_score" >= 0
        )

result_snapshots_confirmed_scores.name: result_snapshots_confirmed_scores
result_snapshots_confirmed_scores.value:
NOT "result_snapshots"."regulation_confirmed"
        OR (
          "result_snapshots"."regulation_home_score" IS NOT NULL
          AND "result_snapshots"."regulation_away_score" IS NOT NULL
        )
